question: Should debrid/decodo (rotating residential, USD 3.75/GB to USD 2/GB) be related to ip-proxy/decodo-isp-proxies, or does the corpus need an ip-proxy record for Decodo rotating residential?
why: The two records are different Decodo products: the debrid record prices the bandwidth-metered rotating residential pool and the ip-proxy record prices static ISP addresses, which the vendor distinguishes (ISP proxies hold a fixed IP, rotating residential proxies do not); no relation fits, so none is proposed and both records stay separate. No ip-proxy record exists for the rotating residential product.
